description: Half of the trades (all UM2, ~60% of the traded notional, 120,000 shares of a small cap) have no volume at all, so their participation is unmeasurable; the measured half (UM1) is tiny. A PASS 'every trade below 10% of ADV' would claim what was not verified.
reviewer_note: Firm on 'not PASS' for the claim 'every trade'; a PASS scoped explicitly to the measured trades with an alert for the rest would also be acceptable but is not what the vocabulary allows.
